why: An arXiv preprint (2608.06538, Anish Gupta) extends the proof of Tuza's conjecture from graphs of maximum degree at most 6 to maximum degree at most 7, using a machine-checked catalogue of 1,144 local certificates; this settles a further case of the conjecture itself, not just a variant.
